summary: Mount Logan Capital's indirect subsidiary Mount Logan Management, LLC signed an asset purchase agreement on October 19, 2026 to acquire from Alternative Fund Advisors, LLC the goodwill, intellectual property and records tied to its management of AFA Asset Based Lending Fund (AMCLX), a registered closed-end fund. Consideration is up to $4.6 million: $300,000 cash at closing plus deferred installments on the first three anniversaries, reducible if AMCLX net assets decline, plus 40% of management and incentive fees for five years. MLM replaces AFA as investment manager and AMCLX's board is reconstituted; closing requires trustee and shareholder approval, with a June 30, 2027 outside date. Watch shareholder vote timing and AMCLX asset retention.
